name: Our Happy End
source:
You play as Yutoya, who is just starting her high school year! Meeting new friends and experience a lot of new things in high school is all teenagers dream right? Or maybe Yutoya will find some familiar faces there and rekindle old lost memories.

[From [url=https://tinartz.itch.io/ourhappyend]itch.io[/url]]
